meta.title: Add GPU little planet support
meta.body_summary: Add GPU-accelerated little planet projection using a shader in CubemapToEquirectangular and wire it into downloadLittlePlanet when GPU is available, with documentation and a regression test.

perf_labels.notes: Sole maintainer self-merged a small GPU feature addition with no review, no benchmark, and sparse evidential signals.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 155 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, self-contained performance feature PR and is consistent with a quick, low-friction merge by the sole maintainer.

review_details.concern_detail: No review or comment text available; the maintainer merged the PR immediately without external feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: GPU-accelerated little planet rendering for better performance compared to a CPU-based path.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent delivered a working GPU feature that was accepted by a sole maintainer without external review; low process friction but also no performance evidence requirements.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after timing, profiler output, or benchmark results; only a functional regression test for output size is provided.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions or review issues observed.

core_change_summary.description: Added toLittlePlanetGpu() to CubemapToEquirectangular using a custom shader for GPU-accelerated little planet projection; wired it into downloadLittlePlanet() when GPU is available; updated README, usage docs, TypeScript definitions, and added a regression test for little planet output dimensions.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation, test, and package script changes support the new GPU feature.
change_trajectory: Single commit adding the GPU shader, integration, test, and documentation.

collaboration_trajectory: Maintainer imgntn committed and immediately merged the PR with no external review.
